# iboss_allowlist_settings (Data Source)

Reads a security group's allowlist settings. Read-only: the documentation describes no update operation for these settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iboss_allowlist_settings" "default" {
  group_number = 1
}

output "default_group_only_allows_allowlist" {
  value = data.iboss_allowlist_settings.default.only_allow_allowlist
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_number` (Number) Security (filtering) group number whose allowlist settings to read. Sent as `currentPolicyBeingEdited`.

### Read-Only

- `default_timed_url_timeout` (Number) Default timeout for timed entries (`defaultTimedUrlTimeout`); the unit is undocumented.
- `display_allowed_sites_page` (Boolean) Display the allowed-sites page (`displayAllowedSitesPage`).
- `group_inheritance_group_number` (Number) Group whose allowlist is inherited (`groupInheritanceGroupNumber`).
- `group_inheritance_policy` (Number) Inheritance policy code (`groupInheritancePolicy`); value meanings are undocumented.
- `id` (String) The group number.
- `only_allow_allowlist` (Boolean) Only allow sites on the allowlist (`onlyAllowWhiteList`).
